subject: math
cluster: Geometric measurement: understand concepts of area and relate area to multiplication and to addition

items.prompt:
Area is measured in
A) square units
B) inches long
C) minutes
D) pounds

$6$ unit squares cover a shape. Area?
A) $6$ square units
B) $6$ units long
C) $12$ square units
D) $3$ square units

Area measures the space a shape
A) covers
B) weighs
C) takes to fall
D) costs

Why no gaps or overlaps when covering with squares?
A) So the area count is correct
B) To use more squares
C) To make it bigger
D) No reason
items.answer: A) So the area count is correct
